Q3 2026 Earnings Report — Sample Corp

Revenue: $4.2 billion, up 18% year-over-year, exceeding analyst estimates of $3.9 billion.
Net income: $890 million, up from $720 million in the prior-year quarter.
Gross margin improved to 42.1% from 39.8%.

Key risks:
- Supply chain constraints in the APAC region continue to pressure hardware margins.
- Foreign exchange headwinds reduced reported revenue by approximately 2 percentage points.
- Increased competition in the core product line from two new market entrants.

Guidance: management raised full-year revenue guidance to $16.8-17.2 billion, up from
the prior range of $16.0-16.5 billion, citing stronger-than-expected enterprise demand.
